igdb_samples.text:
Bound City
An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.
Genres: Role-playing (RPG), Adventure, Indie
Platforms: PC (Microsoft Windows)

NeptuneGL
Enjoy the thrill of the hunt in this 6 degree of freedom space shooter with immersive graphics and multiplayer.
Genres: Shooter, Indie
Platforms: PC (Microsoft Windows)

PilotXross
VR flight game developed for VR devices.The player becomes a [Pilot] flying in the sky with a VRM model, wearing an equipment called [Xross], you can enjoy various ways of flying. The fastest time is to take a commemorative photo and share it on SNS!
Genres: Racing, Sport, Indie
Platforms: SteamVR

Shadowless
Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a creepy house marked by tragedy, where dark entities and the past haunt you. Defenseless, you face a nightmare that consumes you before you can escape.
Genres: Adventure, Indie
Platforms: PC (Microsoft Windows)

Doge Simulator
Doge wants to destroy! Doge wants this whole damn city to be destroyed! Smash the shops, cafes and even the damn palm trees! In our game you play as Doge, and you have to destroy, smash and break!
Genres: Simulator, Indie
Platforms: PC (Microsoft Windows)
